extensionAttribute.description: Time of the next scheduled PresSTORE backup, as ISO 8601.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # PresSTORE Next Backup Time Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
nsdchat="/usr/local/aw/bin/nsdchat"
if [[ ! -x "$nsdchat" ]]; then echo "<result>Not installed</result>" exit 0 fi
cd /usr/local/aw 2>/dev/null || exit 0 workstation=$("$nsdchat" -c Server names 2>/dev/null) nextbackup=$("$nsdchat" -c Server "$workstation" nextrun 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -n "$nextbackup" ]]; then isoDate=$(/bin/date -j -f %s "$nextbackup" "+%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S" 2>/dev/null) echo "<result>$isoDate</result>" else echo "<result>No scheduled backups</result>" fi
